summary.text: Mark Thane is a Democratic state representative from Montana House District 89 who has served in the Montana House since 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former teacher and school administrator, he serves on the House Rules, Education and Taxation committees.

paragraphs.text: Mark Thane was born in Missoula, Montana, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Montana in 1980 and a master's degree from the same university in 1985.
His career experience includes working as a teacher and administrator, and he has been a member of the Montana Federation of Public Employees and the School Administrators of Montana.

Thane has served in the Montana House since 2021; Ballotpedia lists him as the incumbent in District 99 in the 2022 election and in District 89 in 2024, when he defeated incumbent Lyn Hellegaard in the general election.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Rules, Education and Taxation committees (as vice chair of Taxation) and the Agriculture Committee.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Lyn Hellegaard in the general election.
